notes.title: Major Update: Wolves
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that now you can fight against wolves in the Midjungard levels. Wolves can pounce on you at any moment and tear you apart. You can block against wolf attacks, and use your primary or secondary weapons to kill them. You can also set them on fire! 
    Every wolf killed gives you one level up for your character! Opt to fight them head on, or join in with someone else to take them down. Use them to weaken your enemies who are already testing their mettle against them, or steal the bonus points from their would-be kill! Use the wolves to your advantage!

notes.title: Midjungard - The Myrcki Wall Has Been Updated
notes.content: Myrcki is a wall of flesh-eating insects that devour anything living in their path. If a player crosses the Wall of Myrcki he/she will lose health gradually and die. The VFX for the Myrcki wall has been updated and is a significant improvement over the previous texture.

notes.title: First Preview Of Midjungard On Gizorama.com
notes.content:
The first ever preview of Midjungard on the gaming press is out on Gizorama.com.

The preview was not complementary at all about Midjungard, to put it mildly!

Then the Midjungard team swung into action with a vengeance and the results are, shall we say, surprising :)

Check the first ever preview of Midjungard here:

[url=https://gizorama.com/2020/preview/tolkiens-little-viking-midjungard-preview]First ever preview of Midjungard in the gaming press[/url]

notes.title: Midjungard Servers Are Back Online
notes.content: I will be posting a summary of all the gameplay improvements that have been introduced ASAP.

notes.title: Midjungard Servers Down
notes.content: We are bringing in a large set of gameplay fixes from our Beta fleet to the Release fleet. It should be done within 2 hours. Inconvenience is regretted.

notes.title: Midjungard Servers Are Back Online
notes.content:
We are trying to move our AWS fleet to Linux. Yesterday we were not successful. Today we are creating a separate beta fleet on AWS so that we can test our server fixes on the beta fleet without disrupting the fleet where the released version of the server code is being hosted.

Thanks for your understanding.

notes.content: Our AWS fleet is currently running on Windows instances. We are switching to a Linux fleet as we speak. Servers will be up in a couple of hours.

notes.title: Midjungard Servers Down. Will Be Back Online in 2 Hours.

Thanks for your kind understanding.
